methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches AI training program for workplace professionals - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab training workplace professionals signals grassroots AI capability building outside metro centers, demonstrating peer-to-peer skill transfer that could distribute deep competency across Virginia's non-urban regions.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA explicitly targets community-wide AI education and innovation, creating institutional infrastructure for distributed learning networks that could build deep fluency beyond elite tech corridors.

signals.title: Digital Realty Acquires $7.8 bn Northern Virginia Data Center Portfolio from Blackstone to Expand AI Infrastructure - InfotechLead
signals.signal_reading: A $7.8 billion data center acquisition consolidates NoVA's AI infrastructure dominance, deepening capital and capability concentration in the region while creating no mechanisms for knowledge distribution to underserved areas.

signals.title: Virginia budget clears way for $100B Berry Hill data center campus
signals.signal_reading: The $100 billion Berry Hill data center represents infrastructure concentration in rural Southside, but creates shallow local impact—hardware presence without workforce capability development, reinforcing the capital-talent geography mismatch.

signals.title: Virginia county asks all employees, including schools, to conserve power due to AI-driven electricity price hikes — state's 400-plus data centers steadily increasing demand, grid expansion, and pricing - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: AI-driven electricity cost increases forcing county-wide power conservation reveals how concentrated data center growth creates infrastructural burden on local institutions without delivering distributed AI capability or economic resilience to residents.
